primary_target: current manipulation subject; holding a bowl does not mean no target
separate_goal: recipient region is separately unknown, not a negative subject label

development_objective.recall_requirement: no lower than same-protocol original pointer at chosen coverage
development_objective.critical_role_coverage: For each dev role with >=3 visible samples, retain at least one correct accepted box; report per-role recall and rejection, do not pass by rejecting an entire interaction role

statistics: weak geometry/intent proxies, not human intention GT or policy success; report precision and recall with coverage and episode grouping
training: V1-V3 original train only; V4 original train plus first examined cohort (one train/one dev episode per task by sorted ID) and second examined cohort (all train); historical prospective records retained, never reused as holdout claims
regression: old test plus the eight previously examined stage-pilot episodes are now regression, not fresh holdout
confirmation: V1 cohort1, V3 cohort2; V4 cohort3 excludes all 50 examined episodes: 7 source-valid + 1 source-nonvalid selector-unseen, source strata must be reported
methods: label confidence weighting and oracle upper bounds
robot FK and observed depth geometry with explicit measured torso joint input
dense original train/dev sequences; second independent confirmation
autonomous hard class queries and privileged class-only diagnostic upper bounds
causal own-finger and strictly past commanded-action histories
frozen raw action-policy observation features with strict FP32 batch parity
self-predicted future-command auxiliary training, true actions used as loss targets only
paired old28/enlarged108 training populations with old8/new16 development gates
train-only switch-window and acquisition loss emphasis
fixed incumbent/weighting-family probability blends with dual-comparator calibration
predicted-proposal-class confidence and top-two-gap rejection calibration
paired train108 causal finger/strictly past command histories, uniform/switch-weighted losses and incumbent blends
main-view train108 hardest incorrect observed-box ranking, excluding alternate positives and null rivals; paired CE controls and fixed family blends
train108 audited carrier-conflict confidence, factors 1/.5/.25 paired with uniform/transition4 losses and fixed family blends; unchanged main-view inference and full development denominators

train-only stable-subject class-distribution JS consistency, temporal strengths .5/2 versus same-frame dropout strength2 and exact zero controls; null included, public candidate classes pooled without slot matching, no added online inputs
actual epoch13/37 replay of examined priority-vs-F1 history discrepancy; saved real snapshots, reconstruction audit, unchanged full dev gates and fixed blends with original/current frozen parents
deployment: do not replace production model based only on weak-proxy scores; retain causal inputs, missing-target masks and full-scene observations

dense_development_objective.recall_requirement: at least frozen baseline on the same dense dev
dense_development_objective.role_recall_requirement: at least baseline minus .05 for each role with >=10 visible samples; every role with >=3 visible retains >=1 correct accepted target
dense_development_objective.timing: strengthened before dense training and before second confirmation evaluation

v4_priority_objective: In addition to precision/recall and role floors, acquisition wrong-class strictly decreases if baseline>0 and >=10 acquisition samples (else no increase), carry wrong-class does not increase, stable class chatter and stale/correct at gold subject changes do not regress; transition gate enabled at >=3 changes
current_training: 108 train/24 dev episodes, 5794/1243 known unchanged active_subject_v1 labels; source-train growth excludes all previously examined and reserved episodes; old8 and new16 dev checked separately

incumbent_promotion.control: original frozen_for_confirm4 complete configuration, threshold=0 and margin=.2; not development-recalibrated control weights
incumbent_promotion.development: Original pointer V4 AND frozen incumbent V4, on combined24 and old8/new16 separately; compare incumbent accepted recall, not raw recall
incumbent_promotion.confirmation: incumbent_gate_required=true requires the original frozen control; original pointer gate plus incumbent-relative overall and every source-stratum gate must pass
incumbent_promotion.selection: Among eligible configurations, maximize correct-box recall, then fewer acquisition wrong-class errors, then precision
incumbent_promotion.holdout: confirmation6: 16 selector-unseen source-nonvalid episodes, 1265 original frames; upstream visual/policy holdout not established

runtime_bundle: Relocatable public-feature selector only, always labelled research_candidate_not_promoted; bundle parity does not establish reliable intent, raw perception, full task coverage or closed-loop policy success
active_camera_scope: Main-view RGB and observed main depth only; no side/wrist feature enrichment for current ranking, selection or review. Historical wrist trials remain archived.
